How a crossing works. 1. Pick your route and date in the panel above. 2. Choose a sailing and a ticket type — single or return. 3. Arrive at the slipway 15 minutes before departure with your booking reference. Boarding closes 2 minutes before the sailing time. 4. Show your ticket on your phone or in print. Foot passengers walk on; bicycles go in the rack on the aft deck. 5. Crossings between St Aidan's Harbour and Bryher Landing take 35 minutes; to Tern Point add 25 minutes.

Seasonal notes. Table columns: Period — Crossings per day — Last sailing — Notes. 1 April to 31 May: 6 crossings each way — 17:45 — midday sailings run on request only. 1 June to 31 August: 9 crossings each way — 20:15 — extra 06:30 sailing from St Aidan's Harbour on Fridays. 1 September to 31 October: 6 crossings each way — 17:45 — 12:20 sailing on Tern Point route delayed by low tide. 1 November to 31 March: 3 crossings each way — 16:30 — winter timetable, weather-dependent. Bicycles carried free outside these times.

Where to go next. Full timetable: filter every sailing between the three islands and see live status. Button: Open the timetable.
